arms.matched-control: texture-conf's accepted counts per predicted class; within each class, stable descending conf - 1e6*sat

frozen.selection: stable descending global top ceil(0.8*N); the same score serves A and B
frozen.veto_budget_rule: flagged tiles rank below every unflagged tile and the count stays ceil(0.8*N); if flags exceed 20% of N, the flagged tiles with the highest zero-label scores are accepted
frozen.texture_scope: q_multiscale and P_cc are computed only on predicted-cloud tiles of the single forward; P_cc is 0 elsewhere

bootstrap.protocol: tasks/zero-label-s2-test: default_rng(7) whole-ROI draws, stable-sorted concatenation, recomputed cut

costs.boundary: model load and band read/decode through the complete global texture-conf decision; reference all-tile texture, parity checks, labels and statistics excluded

decision: row 3, increment holds: texture-conf is the recommended configuration, reported as a pre-frozen supplementary evaluation on a used test set; the zero-label rule is the key comparison arm
mechanism_wording: texture improves which cloud calls are accepted, beyond accepting fewer cloud calls
scope: pre-frozen supplementary evaluation on a used test set: the 165 ROIs were exposed through the learned head, the gates and the zero-label rule; texture arms never scored here before
